paragraphs.text: Local Russian speech recognition for DeepSeek Harness: GigaAM v3 via sherpa-onnx, fully offline
Local **Russian** speech recognition for DeepSeek Harness.

The plugin does not replace the built-in Voice input: it adds a provider to the shared
`ctx.speechTo
Text` service, so the microphone button, recording and text insertion stay stock.
